names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 martie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Vasile, preotul din Ancira».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Βασίλειος Ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος Άγκυρας», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 22 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свештеномученик Василије, презвитер анкирски.“, with the rank word Свештеномученик left off and with презвитер анкирски left off as well — a rank and a see this folder already keeps in `types` and `office`. The heading gives no epithet, so the bare forename is what the source gives, and it folds with `basil-the-confessor` and `basileus-of-cherson`.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 22 martie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Vasile, preotul din Ancira»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Βασίλειος Ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος Άγκυρας»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The Greek line matches this folder exactly — Ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος Άγκυρας, hieromartyr and presbyter of Ancyra, on 22 March. It heads him «(; - 362)» and names one relic, «Απότμημα του Ιερού Λειψάνου του Αγίου βρίσκεται στη Μονή Μπούρα Μεγαλοπόλεως», a portion at the monastery of Boura in Megalopolis. saint.gr also keeps a separate «Άγιος Βασίλειος Μάρτυρας εξ Άγκυρας» on 2 Ιανουαρίου, on its own page, who is also of Ancyra and also tortured by Saturninus under Julian but dies otherwise — sent bound to Caesarea and torn by a lioness while standing in prayer — with different relics, a different couplet and no priestly rank. That is a second entry on the same calendar and therefore, by the corpus's settled rule, a second commemoration; nothing has been written into this folder from it, and the question is in the reader's report.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.04.2026 (22. март ст. ст.) — „Свештеномученик Василије, презвитер анкирски.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same presbyter of Ancyra: a zealot for Orthodoxy who suffered much from the Arians under Constantius and was killed under Julian the Apostate. The Prologue dates his death 363, where this folder holds 362 from the other calendars; the sourced year is left standing and the disagreement is recorded here rather than resolved. It gives the trial and the two speeches the other pages did not, and the seven strips of skin flayed from him daily. The stored form is the bare forename, because Свештеномученик is a rank this folder's `types` already carry and презвитер анкирски is the rank and the see it keeps in `types` and `office`; the bare „Василије“ therefore folds with `basil-the-confessor` and `basileus-of-cherson`, which hold the same bare form, and that fold is recorded as deliberate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the two hymns here are the other calendars'.

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţa răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Vasile, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfinţit Mucenic Vasile, preotul din Ancira

english.text: Sharing in the ways of the Apostles and succeeding to their thrones, thou didst find in action, O God-inspired one, a path to the vision of the things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in faith even unto blood, O hieromartyr Basil, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Θείου Πνεύματος, τὴ ἐπινεύσει, χρῖσμα ἅγιον, ἱεροσύνης, ἐπαξίως ὑπεδέξω Βασίλειε, ὅθεν ὡς θῦμα βασίλειον ἔθυσας, τῷ βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων τοὺς ἄθλους σου. Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως, on the page of Άγιος Βασίλειος Ιερομάρτυρας Πρεσβύτερος Άγκυρας. It names him, names his priesthood and plays on the name three times over — θῦμα βασίλειον offered to the βασιλεύς of the ages — so it is his own and not a common. It is the only hymn the page prints.

english.text: By the inclining of the divine Spirit thou didst worthily receive the holy chrism of priesthood, O Basil; whence as a royal victim thou didst offer thy contests to the King of the ages. O venerable father, entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.

death.note: saint.gr: «Έτσι μαρτύρησε ο Άγιος Βασίλειος, το έτος 362 μ.Χ. και έλαβε το αμαράντινο στέφανο της δόξας του Θεού», and it heads him «(; - 362)». It places him «στα χρόνια του Ιουλιανού του Παραβάτη (360-363)», in the years of Julian the Apostate, and 362 falls inside that reign. doxologia.ro gave no year at all.
